setup.prerequisites: uv, mamba, GCC/G++ 11, make, curl, git, zlib development headers; existing NVIDIA driver

fixes: Declared opencv-python-headless dependency required by the COLMAP camera loader.
Fetch OptiX headers without importing the renderer runtime.
Include CUDA math-library development headers in the reference environment recipe.
Fix JPEG decoder implementation as well as Pillow version to reproduce original input RGB.
CUDA validation imports the installed package instead of injecting the checkout into sys.path.
limitations: This validates installation and a short end-to-end path, not 30000-step convergence or full-training speed.
RTX 4070 SUPER versus RTX 4090 training was not bit-identical; exact equality claims here concern same-GPU runs.
The continuation diagnostic reconstructs checkpoint state; the general training CLI does not yet provide a --resume flag.
Decoder choice is part of the input protocol; ordinary PyPI Pillow wheels need not decode identically.
Source build requires the documented system prerequisites and access to public dependencies.
evaluation_notice: 610-step metrics in validation/checkpoint_evaluation.json test execution only; they are not final benchmark quality.
